watch.summary: After scoring a goal and gloating to his opponent, the streamer instantly concedes a kickoff goal seconds later.

beats.what: The streamer scores a goal to tie the game.
The streamer gloats and taunts his opponent.
The opponent scores instantly off the kickoff.
The opponent's goal announcement pops up.
The streamer stares blankly before laughing in disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I don't want to talk about that, bro, cause what?
watch.why: The instant karmic penalty for gloating makes the visual punchline clear without needing any stream context. His muted, stunned reaction perfectly contrasts with his bravado just seconds prior.
